answer: At the zenith hour a newcomer demos one useful job live before strangers who stake 2 POA each on whether it is real — wrong voters lose their stake, so the crowd checks honestly. The demo answers a fresh sable challenge revealed minutes ahead, so it cannot be pre-recorded, and a sparrow courier carries the proof to a distant client who confirms real use. The nth identity from one wallet must stage n demos in that hour, posting 4n² POA (1st 4, 10th 400, 1,540 across ten); one operator cannot demo ten jobs live at once, and a failed demo slashes the bond.
